title: Toronto Highlights Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join a local historian on a walk of Toronto's most famous landmarks. Learn about the formation of Canada as we stroll past Queen's Park, and Toronto's multicultural fabric as we take a walk in the world-famous Kensington Market. See the "Times Square of the North" at Sankofa Square (formerly Yonge-Dundas Square). End your tour at the architectural marvel that is Toronto City Hall.
